label: Town of Burke
header:
# Town of Burke municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 4; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Burke Selectboard members: Joseph Allard, Gerald Booth, and Mark Daigle (Chair).
Town of Burke official website, Boards & Commissions page (Selectboard tab): lists Mark Daigle (Chair), Jerry Booth, and Joe Allard.
Town of Burke official website, Offices & Departments page: names Linda Hackett-Corey as Town Clerk.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Linda Hackett-Corey as Town Clerk of Burke.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Kathleen Feeley as Treasurer of Burke.

Town of Burke official website, Offices & Departments page: names the Town Treasurer as 'Cathi Feeley'; the town's Justices of the Peace page and the Secretary of State's sources print Kathleen Feeley, the form recorded here.

Town of Burke, 2026 Town Meeting Warning: Article 4 warns election of a Town Moderator (Australian ballot). The town's official results publish no names, and the name printed on the sample ballot is a candidacy, not a certified result, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.

Town of Burke, 2026 Town Meeting Warning: Article 4 warns election of one Constable (Australian ballot). The town's official results publish no names, and the name printed on the sample ballot is a candidacy, not a certified result, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.

sources.note: Town of Burke, 2026 Town Meeting Warning: Article 4 warns election of an Agent to Convey Real Estate (Australian ballot); the 2026 ballot offered the office by write-in only. No official source names a holder, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Burke justices of the peace: Wendy Bean, Susan Carr, Anthony (Tony) DeMasi, Kathleen Feeley, Joel Gilbert, Joan Harlowe, and John Kascenska. The town website's justices page names a different set of six (including a Daniel Tanner and omitting Harlowe); the Secretary of State listing governs the election record.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Burke justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
